notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental statement lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp5-6); business-type lines from the modified cash proprietary funds statement Total column (p8), which ties to the Statement of Activities business-type expenditures 439,334 and charges for services 406,723 (p2). Business-type receipts total computed (operating revenues + interest income); disbursements total = Statement of Activities business-type expenditures (p2). Fund balances pp6/4; cash from the governmental funds statement (2023 and 2022 Totals columns, p4), computed as the sum of the cash lines; investments separate. Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1) because the governmental funds statement includes interfund due to/from (totals differ). Detail: per fund column of the governmental funds statement (General, Street, Debt Service, Sales Tax), the nonmajor combining statement (Clinic, Cemetery Perpetual Care, Community Development; p10) and the proprietary statement (Lottery, Water, Sewer); the all-funds budget schedule (p11) is a combined schedule and is not recorded.
